# Product Name

> One or two plain sentences: what it is, who it's for, and the main benefit. Same facts as the site and README.

A short paragraph with the key facts an assistant should get right: how to install or start, platforms, license and price, and what makes it different. No marketing language, and no claims that aren't on the site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): what it is and how it works
- [Install](https://example.com/install/): install, update and uninstall commands
- [Features](https://example.com/features/): each feature in one line
- [FAQ](https://example.com/faq/): direct answers to common questions
